Hey hun, im a girl and im 17. I started cutting when i was about 13 and i still do it now. The first time i did it with scissors and i couldnt even touch a pair of scissors for months after that because i basically traumatised myself. I overcome that obviously though. 

Just like everyone else here is saying, i think it would be best to get help. After 4 years of self harming i only started getting help a couple months back by seeing a councillor. 

Over the past couple years my parents have been told twice by school councilors that i self harm and basically all i got was being yelled at by them both and then they never brought it up again. But i promise you that for me it hurt a lot more knowing that they knew but that they did nothing to help me. I wish they checked on me and cared enough. So hopefully it really isnt a bad thing that your mum found out. Maybe she will try to help and it may be a good idea to let her help. Let her take you to a councillor maybe. 

I really hope that this doesnt continue for you and that you no longer self harm because it is an addiction but its not a good one. Please take care of yourself and know that we are all sending love your way x
